<div class="card-body">
'''Debris Zone''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Used Interrupt]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">破片の散乱</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ＡＴ－ＡＴ、「ジャバのセイル・バージ」、「惑星防衛用イオン砲」のいずれかが位置でロストした直後に使用する。運命数を引く。その位置にある、同じ運命数を持ったすべてのカードはロストする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Debris-Zone-PSA-151452821.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">破壊されたＡＴ－ＡＴの反応炉は激しく爆発し、装甲版を突き破ってプラズマが噴出する。周囲には融解した構造材が雨となって降り注ぐのだ。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Scattered fragments.

'''Card text:'''
Use immediately after an AT-AT, Jabba's Sail Barge or Planet Defender Ion Cannon is lost at a site. Draw destiny. All cards at that site with that destiny number are lost.

'''Lore:'''
The reactor of a destroyed AT-AT explodes violently, and plasma bursts through the armor. Molten structural debris rains on the surroundings.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese omits AT-ST from the lost-card list.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Debris Zone]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
